definition: Whole-animal metabolic rate measured at rest in a thermoneutral, post-absorptive animal.
note: The merge carries both BMR_wholeanimal (mL O2/h) and BMR_massspecific (mL O2/h/g).

definition: A direct (monosynaptic) connection from a corticospinal axon onto a spinal motoneuron.
note: CM_connection_inference is Bortoff & Strick's own conservative inference about such a connection, not a direct observation.

definition: Brain plus spinal cord.
source: Burish_etal_2010/Burish_etal_2010_definitions.csv ("%MCNS" / "%NCNS" defined as fractions of "the CNS mass; brain + spinal cord")

definition: The descending motor pathway from cerebral cortex to spinal cord; also called the pyramidal tract.
source: _keys/variable_catalog.csv (Heffner_Masterton_1975 "number of fibres in the pyramidal (corticospinal) tract"; Bortoff_Strick_1993)

definition: A torpor phenotype in which torpor bouts last less than about 24 h and recur on a daily cycle.
source: Ruf_Geiser_2015/Ruf_Geiser_2015_Table1.ReadMe.md ("T — torpor type: DT (daily torpor) or HIB (hibernation)")
note: One of the two values of Torpor_type.

definition: Ratio of the total (inner + buried) cortical contour to the superficially exposed (outer) contour on coronal sections. GI = 1 means no folding; higher values mean more folded.
note: NOT the same quantity as the Mota & Herculano-Houzel folding index (FI) — the catalog records that these are distinct and are never pooled.

definition: Liu et al. 2016's headline composite measure of manipulative potential, computed from hand segment proportions.
note: Carried into the app under the name Manipulability_index by ____EvoM1_TraitTable/EvoM1_read_hand_liu.R.

definition: A laterality index for hand preference; the mean is signed (direction of bias) and the strength is its absolute value.
note: Underlying source is Caspar 2022 per __merging_behaviour/README__merging.md.

definition: A torpor phenotype with multi-day torpor bouts, typically seasonal.
note: The other value of Torpor_type.

definition: Astrocytes with a soma in cortical layer I that extend an interlaminar process running perpendicular to the pia into deeper cortical layers.
note: Falcone et al. 2019 distinguish pial ILA (present in all mammals sampled) from subpial ILA (absent in Marsupialia), and rudimentary (process does not exit layer I) from "typical" ILA (process exits layer I).

definition: The electron-dense specialisation on the postsynaptic membrane of a synapse; its length is used as an ultrastructural proxy for synapse size.
The sleep state characterised by rapid eye movements, low-voltage fast EEG and muscle atonia; also called paradoxical sleep.
Non-REM sleep characterised by high-amplitude slow EEG waves.
Core body temperature. Torpor_Tb_min_C is the minimum body temperature reached in torpor, in degrees Celsius.
Total time spent asleep, normally per 24 h.
note: Appears in this repo only inside the label USWS_pctTST (USWS as a percent of TST).

definition: Slow-wave sleep occurring in one cerebral hemisphere at a time while the other remains awake — the cetacean/avian sleep pattern.
note: In this repo USWS is expressed as a percentage of total sleep time (USWS_pctTST).

definition: The reachable manipulative workspace of the hand, as defined by Liu et al. 2016.
note: Related to but distinct from Baker et al. 2025 peak_workspace (Feix et al. 2015 metric).

definition: Surface or sectional area of the structure in square centimetres.
Total number of cells (neurons plus non-neuronal cells) in the structure.
source: DosSantos_etal_2020/DosSantos_etal_2020_definitions.csv ("C" = Total number of cells in the structure)

definition: Total number of microglial cells in the structure.
source: DosSantos_etal_2020/DosSantos_etal_2020_definitions.csv ("I" = Total number of microglia in the structure)
note: I is for Iba1, the antigen used to identify microglia in Dos Santos et al. 2020.

definition: Microglia-to-total-cell ratio for the structure.

definition: Number of microglia per milligram of structure tissue.
source: DosSantos_etal_2020/DosSantos_etal_2020_definitions.csv ("I/mg" = Number of microglia per milligram of structure)

definition: Microglia-to-neuron ratio for the structure.

source: Burish_etal_2010/Burish_etal_2010_definitions.csv ("Length" = average length of the structure (in millimetres))
note: In this repo it carries spinal-cord length (Burish LSC).

definition: Mass of the structure in the unit the source paper printed; unit not fixed by the code.
note: Unit-agnostic legacy code. Check the source table before combining with Mass.g.

definition: Mass of the structure (or of the body) in grams.
applies_to: brain structure & size; cellular composition; body size

definition: Mass in kilograms, normally body mass as printed.
Number of individuals (specimens) analysed for that structure.
note: Sample size, not a trait — role=info.

definition: Total number of neurons in the structure.
source: DosSantos_etal_2020/DosSantos_etal_2020_definitions.csv ("N" = Total number of neurons in the structure); Burish_etal_2010/Burish_etal_2010_definitions.csv ("N" = average number of neurons)
note: Reading VERIFIED from two independent per-paper definitions files: N = neurons. The trailing .n means "a count".

definition: Number of neurons per milligram of structure tissue (neuronal density).
source: DosSantos_etal_2020/DosSantos_etal_2020_definitions.csv ("N/mg"); Burish_etal_2010/Burish_etal_2010_definitions.csv ("DN" = average density of neurons per milligram of tissue)
note: ".p." reads as "per".

definition: Total number of non-neuronal ("other") cells in the structure.
source: Burish_etal_2010/Burish_etal_2010_definitions.csv ("O" = average number of other (nonneuronal) cells in the structure); _keys/HerculanoHouzel/anatomy_key.csv ("Amygdala_Non-neuronal cells" -> O.n)
note: Reading VERIFIED: O = other / non-neuronal cells, not oligodendrocytes. Called "other cells" because the isotropic fractionator does not distinguish glia from endothelium.

definition: Number of non-neuronal cells per milligram of structure tissue.

definition: Ratio of non-neuronal cells to neurons in the structure (the glia:neuron-like ratio of the isotropic-fractionator literature).

definition: The structure's mass expressed as a percentage of whole-body mass.
source: Burish_etal_2010/Burish_etal_2010_definitions.csv ("%MBD" = average structure mass fraction (expressed as percentage of the whole body mass))
note: In this repo it carries spinal cord as % of body mass.

definition: The structure expressed as a percentage of the whole brain (volume fraction).
source: _keys/variable_catalog.csv (Kverkova_etal_2018) ("average structure volume fractions (expressed as percentage of the whole brain volume)")

definition: The structure's mass expressed as a percentage of central-nervous-system mass (brain + spinal cord).

definition: A dimensionless ratio of two measured quantities; which two is fixed by the source table, not by the code.
note: Unit-agnostic. Always read the source row for what is being divided by what.

definition: Number of samples of free nuclei prepared with the isotropic fractionator for that structure.
note: Methodological effort, not a biological trait — role=info.

definition: Standard deviation of the accompanying measure across the individuals sampled.

definition: Which source publication or printing the accompanying value was taken from.

definition: Absolute volume of the structure in cubic millimetres.

definition: Absolute volume of the structure in cubic millimetres. Underscore spelling of Vol.mm3 used by the Stephan-collection anatomy key.
